types.name: PointCloudScannerComponent
types.doc:
A LiDAR scanner mounted on an entity. While it fires, the PointCloud
module's scanner system turns it into shots from the entity's world
position along its world forward, at scansPerSecond, and hands them to the
scene's scan service: traced into this player's own cloud and, in a
session, reported so every other player re-traces them into theirs.
Gameplay drives `firing` (a trigger held); `autoFire` is for a turret or
an authored demo that scans on its own.

members.name: coneDegrees
members.doc: Full cone angle; a shot takes half of it as its half-angle.

members.name: densityFalloff
members.doc: >1 concentrates rays toward the axis, 1 spreads them over the cap.

members.name: rangeBand
members.doc:
1 far (8 cm grid), 2 normal (4 cm), 3 precise (1.5 cm); 0 uses the
cloud's own grid. Stamped on every point the scanner makes.

members.name: cloudMaxPoints
members.doc:
This machine's whole point budget, and the share of it other players'
scans may fill. Read when the scene's scan service first attaches.

members.name: fillRays
members.doc:
The Fill: one sphere of rays that paints the room around the scanner,
released outward as a wavefront at waveSpeed rather than in one frame.

members.name: traceBackend
members.doc:
0 auto = 3, the deterministic scan hierarchy over the level's render
triangles: every client re-traces a replicated shot to the same points
bit for bit. 1 the physics colliders (Jolt), 2 the Embree scan
hierarchy (ScanHierarchy plugin) — faster, but neither is the same
cloud on every machine.

members.name: fillRequested
members.doc: Set to fire one Fill; the system clears it.

members.name: activeBackend
members.doc:
The trace the scene's scan service ended up on: 0 not yet fired, 1
Jolt colliders, 2 the Embree scan hierarchy, 3 the deterministic one.
Read-only in the details panel, so a designer can see which one ran.

types.name: ScanMeshComponent
types.doc:
How an entity appears to the LiDAR scan (audit S4). Without one, a static
mesh scans as its render triangles and a moving one is not in the scan
scene at all. With one, an authored scan mesh can stand in for the render
mesh (the render mesh is the wrong resolution for a 1.5 cm precise band,
the collider the wrong content), a moving body is traced as a live
instance, and an animated character gets a capsule per bone that follows
its pose.

members.name: exclude
members.doc:
Invisible to the scanner: glass the design wants to see through, a
trigger volume that happens to carry a mesh.

members.name: scanMesh
members.doc: A dedicated scan mesh (a model asset); empty scans the render mesh.

members.name: scanTag
members.doc: Scan response tag; -1 takes the collider's surface type.

members.name: layer
members.doc:
Auto: static bodies are the static world, moving ones props,
characters (anything with bone capsules) characters.

members.name: dynamic
members.doc:
Traced where it is every frame, not where it was when the scene was
built. On by default for any body that is not static.

members.name: boneCapsules
members.doc: A capsule per bone of the entity's animator, posed every frame.
